Reasoning that cannot live on a mutant (the tracked-spec gate pins the field set): M1 -- this is the F1 defect shape: read unbounded chunks, notice the overshoot afterwards | M2 -- removing only the SIGTERM is equivalent, because escalation still reaps the group; the contract that can actually be broken is terminate-and-prove-empty | M5 -- structural memory/disk control: any second full copy of the capture doubles disk | M6 -- non-vacuity: an always-UNKNOWN recorder must not satisfy the bound contracts | M7 -- R6 carries its own timeout so this regression fails the gate instead of wedging the suite | M10 -- missing cleanup evidence is a failure, not a successful no-op | M11/M12 pin IR-1 (every recorder-owned path removed; the refusal is a real artifact). | M13/M14 pin IR-2 (a residual group is terminated, and refuses an otherwise complete capture). | M15/M16 pin IR-3 (parse mode declares its own accounting; a nonpositive budget is refused). | M17/M12 pin RR-1 (one sentinel-safe cleanup boundary; a failed setup still publishes). | M18/M19 pin RR-2 (the exception path reaps the group and records the proof).
